cond_0001.intro: The Production Quality Inspector will be responsible for receiving and confirming defective material. Other responsibilities include diligently tracking parts, troubleshooting, and dispositioning material. Developing relationships with other cross-functional departments to drive disposition of parts and evaluating the concern versus the return.

Building relationships with other cross-functional departments is a central part of the role, helping to drive disposition of parts and evaluating the concern versus the return.
cond_0537.responsibilities:
Perform database transactions to manage the tracking, receiving, storing of failed parts
Systematically marking parts special interest for expedited return to engineers and technicians
Route parts back to Suppliers, Quality Engineering, or Recycling based on guidance and instructions — staying in contact with each group to clarify next steps
Maintain data integrity, accuracy and efficiency of defect material throughput and systematically logging information
Provide data input and output reports to assist in driving improvements
Conduct audits and support corrective actions based on defect reason, actively contributing to discussions around findings
Disposition defect material and sort material by viewing work instructions
Maintain 5S and MRB best practices
cond_0537.requirements:
Technical background and troubleshooting knowledge
Strong communication skills and ability to build strong partnerships across various organizations within [Company name masked]
Ability to work independently and stay on task without direct supervision
Must be detail orientated, reliable, have good initiative, determination, and quality focused
Ability to perform repetitious duties while standing for long periods
Ability to lift up to 50 lbs
Valid driver's license and ability to drive a forklift
cond_0537.workplace_support: We are committed to creating a workforce that reflects society through inclusive programs and initiatives such as equal pay, employee resource groups, and inclusive benefits. We want employees from different backgrounds to feel supported and able to thrive.
